## About This Site

Krishna Multispeciality Dental Clinic is a specialist dental clinic located at 10/181-1 Eluru Road, Gudivada, Andhra Pradesh 521301, India. The clinic offers comprehensive dental care including restorative, cosmetic, orthodontic, oral surgery, and preventive dentistry services. The lead dentist is Dr. Vidya Sahithi Atluri, MDS (Prosthodontist).

Contact: +91-86742-44241 | +91-79974-44241
Email: vidya@krishnadental.in
Hours: Mon–Sat 9:30 AM–8:30 PM | Sun 10:00 AM–1:00 PM
